name: bHaptics TactGlove Demo
summary:
Introducing a bHaptics’ TactGlove demo created using the First Hand open source by Meta.

In this demo, you can enjoy natural and realistic haptic feedback with TactGlove while trying out various hand tracking activities, such as pressing button, pulling levers, building superpower gloves, shooting lasers, and blocking enemy attacks with a shield.
You can also high-five, fist-bump, hug, and shake hands with your mirror avatar to experience interacting with other people in the Metaverse.
